title: Wave X — Lifecycle & State Transitions
scope: Agent lifecycle: deploy, run, update, terminate — and their invariants
topics: Deploy invariant (after deploy, service is reachable)
Update atomicity (new config replaces old atomically)
Service restart (if stopped, can be restarted)
Graceful termination (pending work completed before exit)
proof_principle: Every proof proves what is already declared in the model. No new types, predicates, or invariants.
